description: A miniature pastel idol companion closely based on the latest original reference: fluffy pastel pink hair fading toward pale white, large blue-violet eyes, fair skin, soft playful smile, black tiny doll-shaped bangs accessory, cat-ear-like white and pink bow accessory, white fur trim, white and pastel pink outfit with black ribbon accents, blue jewel details, glossy red gloves, chain detail, and a small dark plush charm.
